note: Reviewed todos.ts ↔ agent-team.ts integration potential. Key architectural facts: (1) subagents spawn with --no-extensions plus explicit allowlist (team-comms, domain-lock, web-fetch); todos.ts never loads in subagents. (2) domain-lock.ts enforces write paths; no agent has .pi/todos access. (3) AgentState is ephemeral in-memory Map; todos are durable file-backed. (4) dispatcher is locked to dispatch_agent tool only via setActiveTools. (5) todo assignment uses session file paths, but subagent sessions are wiped every dispatcher session_start. Conclusion: integration creates more problems than it solves for short-lived tasks; only viable as dispatcher-level opt-in for multi-session goals.
